name: Big Sur Sunday
notes:
BRING YOUR OWN CHAIR
This is a 90 minute speaker discussion Alcoholics Anonymous meeting with a wonderful setting within the redwood forest of Big Sur. The chairperson shares during the first part of the meeting, we take a short break and then resume for the discussion portion of the meeting. The group generally meets outside with chairs circled beneath the redwoods. During rain or colder weather we meet inside the building.
